package rulefixtures

// scenario for goroutine_for_sync_work: `go func() { result <- compute() }()` followed by `<-result` where the goroutine is immediately awaited
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func computeSum(nums []int) int {
	done := make(chan int)
	var result int
	go func() {
		sum := 0
		for _, n := range nums {
			sum += n
		}
		result = sum
		done <- 1
	}()
	<-done
	return result
}
